你希望最后拿到的东西长什么样？: What should the finished thing look like?
这是最容易被忽略、但对结果影响最大的一步。选错了形态，内容再好也不好用。: This is the most easily overlooked step and the one that affects the result most. Pick the wrong form and even good content ends up unusable.
以结构化报告的形式输出，使用 Markdown 二级标题分节，层级清晰。: Output a structured report, divided into sections with Markdown level-2 headings and a clear hierarchy.
以编号步骤的形式输出，每一步都是可以直接执行的动作。: Output numbered steps, each one an action that can be carried out directly.
用连贯的自然段落回答，就像面对面聊天一样，不要使用小标题、项目符号或编号列表。: Answer in flowing natural paragraphs, the way you would talk face to face. Do not use subheadings, bullet points or numbered lists.
一眼看清差异: See the differences at a glance
以 Markdown 表格形式输出对比结果，便于横向比较。: Present the comparison as a Markdown table so the options can be read side by side.
输出一篇结构完整的成稿，可以直接拿去发布，不需要我再补充内容。: Output a complete, structured piece that can be published as-is, with nothing left for me to fill in.
输出可直接运行的完整代码，并在关键位置附上必要的注释说明。: Output complete, runnable code with the necessary comments at the key points.
只输出层级分明的结构大纲，用嵌套列表表达从属关系，不要展开成完整句子。: Output only a clearly tiered outline, using nested lists for the relationships. Do not expand anything into full sentences.
输出可直接发送的完整消息体，包含合适的称呼与结尾。: Output a complete message body that can be sent as-is, with an appropriate greeting and sign-off.
按幻灯片逐页组织内容，每页给出标题与 3-5 个要点，要点尽量短。: Organize the content slide by slide, with a title and three to five short points on each.
报告大概要多长？: Roughly how long should the report be?
全文控制在 800 字以内，只保留结论与最关键的两三条论据。: Keep the whole thing under 800 words, with only the conclusion and the two or three pieces of evidence that matter most.
全文约 1200-1800 字，论据完整但每一句都要有信息量。: Around 1200-1800 words, with complete evidence where every sentence carries information.
背景、推演、风险全覆盖: Background, reasoning and risk, all covered
全文不少于 2500 字，需要覆盖背景、分析、推演过程、风险与建议。: At least 2500 words, covering the background, the analysis, the reasoning, the risks and the recommendations.
报告里必须包含哪些部分？: Which parts must the report include?
可以多选。: You can pick more than one.
开头先给出一段结论摘要，让读者三秒内知道核心判断。: Open with a short summary of the conclusion, so the reader knows the core judgement within three seconds.
每个论点都必须跟随具体证据、数据或案例支撑，不允许只有观点没有依据。: Every claim must be followed by specific evidence, data or an example. No claim without support.
把数据放表格里: Put the numbers in a table
关键数据用表格呈现，表格要有明确的表头与单位。: Present the key figures in tables, with clear headers and units.
也说说哪里会翻车: Say where it could go wrong
专门用一节说明风险、反方观点和可能推翻结论的条件。: Give risks, opposing views and the conditions that would overturn the conclusion their own dedicated section.
结尾给出可执行的行动清单，每条标明负责人角色与优先级。: End with an actionable list, each item marked with the role responsible and its priority.
列出还需要我拍板的: List what still needs my call
最后列出仍需我确认或补充信息的问题，不要替我臆断。: Finish with the questions that still need my confirmation or more information. Do not assume an answer on my behalf.
步骤要拆到多细？: How finely should the steps be broken down?
把流程拆成 3-5 个大步骤，每步用一句话说明目标。: Break the process into three to five major steps, each described by a single sentence stating its goal.
每个步骤下面补充「做什么、怎么做、做完是什么样」三个要素。: Under each step, add three things: what to do, how to do it, and what it looks like when it is done.
细到不用思考: Detailed enough to need no thought
把每个步骤拆成可直接勾选的原子动作，包含具体的工具、参数或话术。: Break each step into atomic actions that can be ticked off directly, including the specific tools, settings or wording.
你希望回答多长？: How long should the answer be?
整段回答控制在 200 字以内，直接说重点，不要任何铺垫。: Keep the whole answer under 200 words. Get straight to the point with no preamble.
用一到两段话说清楚，长度在 300-500 字之间。: Say it in one or two paragraphs, somewhere between 300 and 500 words.
可以展开多聊几层，但保持自然段落，不要变成列表。: Feel free to go a few layers deeper, but keep it in natural paragraphs rather than turning it into a list.
表格里要比哪些维度？: Which dimensions should the table compare?
表格需包含「核心特点」列，用一句话概括。: The table must include a Core traits column, summarised in one sentence.
表格需包含「优势」列。: The table must include a Strengths column.
表格需包含「局限或代价」列，必须写实，不要空着。: The table must include a Limits or cost column. Be honest in it — do not leave it blank.
表格需包含「适用场景」列，说明什么条件下该选它。: The table must include a When to use it column, stating the conditions under which it is the right choice.
表格需包含「成本或门槛」列，包含时间、金钱与学习成本。: The table must include a Cost or barrier column covering time, money and learning effort.
表格最后一列给出「建议」，明确写出推荐或不推荐。: The final column gives a Recommendation, stating plainly whether it is advised or not.
文章大概要写多长？: Roughly how long should the article be?
全文约 800 字，围绕一个核心观点展开。: About 800 words, built around a single core idea.
全文约 1500-2000 字，有完整起承转合。: About 1500-2000 words, with a complete arc: setup, development, turn and resolution.
全文不少于 3000 字，需要有层层递进的论证与足够的具体案例。: At least 3000 words, with an argument that builds layer by layer and plenty of concrete examples.
文章用什么结构？: What structure should the article use?
开头用一个具体的场景、反常识的事实或尖锐的问题抓住读者，中段展开论证，结尾收束回: Open with a concrete scene, a counter-intuitive fact or a sharp question to catch the reader. Develop the argument in the middle, then bring it back to the theme at the end.
用一条完整的故事线或案例贯穿全文，把观点融进叙事里，不要写成论说文。: Carry the whole piece on one story or case, folding the ideas into the narrative instead of writing a treatise.
用并列的小节结构组织全文，每一节独立成立，读者可以跳读。: Organize the piece into parallel sections, each standing on its own so a reader can skip around.
用连续的问题推进全文，每回答一个问题就引出下一个，形成层层递进的节奏。: Drive the piece with a run of questions: each answer raises the next, building a step-by-step rhythm.
你没说，让 AI 选: You did not say — let the AI pick
它会选最常见的: It will pick the most common one
技术栈未指定时，请选择最主流、社区支持最好的方案，并在开头说明你的选择理由。: When the stack is not specified, choose the most mainstream option with the best community support, and explain your choice at the start.
请使用 Python 实现，遵循 PEP 8 风格。: Implement this in Python, following PEP 8.
请使用 JavaScript 或 TypeScript 实现，遵循现代 ES 规: Implement this in JavaScript or TypeScript, following modern ES conventions.
代码要怎么讲给我听？: How should the code be explained to you?
看代码就懂: The code should speak for itself
在关键逻辑处写行内注释，解释「为什么这么写」而不是「这行在干什么」。: Add inline comments at the key logic explaining why it is written this way, not what the line does.
代码之后单独用一段文字说明整体思路、关键取舍与可能的坑。: After the code, add a separate passage explaining the overall approach, the key trade-offs and the likely pitfalls.
既要在关键处写行内注释，也要在代码之后补充整体思路说明。: Add inline comments at the key points, and a passage after the code explaining the overall approach.
只输出代码，不需要额外说明。: Output only the code, with no extra explanation.
大纲要拆到第几层？: How many levels should the outline go to?
大纲拆到两层即可，第二层用短语而非完整句子。: Two levels is enough; the second level should be phrases rather than full sentences.
大纲拆到三层，第三层要具体到可以直接动笔的程度。: Three levels, with the third specific enough to start writing from directly.
三层 + 每节写什么: Three levels + what each section covers
在层级大纲的基础上，为每一节附上一句话说明「这一节要讲什么、用什么材料」。: On top of the tiered outline, add one sentence per section saying what it covers and what material it draws on.
这封消息的沟通姿态是？: What is this message trying to do?
沟通目的是推动事情落地，结尾必须给出明确的下一步与时间预期。: The purpose is to get something done. The ending must give a clear next step and a time expectation.
沟通目的是同步信息，重点是把背景、现状和影响讲清楚，不需要对方立刻回应。: The purpose is to share information. The focus is on making the background, the current state and the impact clear. No immediate reply is needed.
沟通目的是争取支持，需要先讲清对方能获得什么，再提我的诉求。: The purpose is to win support. Explain what they get out of it first, then make the ask.
沟通目的是处理负面情况，要先承担责任、说明现状，再给补救方案，不要辩解。: The purpose is to handle a bad situation. Take responsibility first, explain where things stand, then offer a remedy. Do not make excuses.
整体控制在 5-8 页，每页只讲一个要点。: Keep it to five to eight pages, with one point per page.
整体 10-15 页，需要有完整的背景、方案、支撑与结论。: Ten to fifteen pages, with a complete background, proposal, supporting material and conclusion.
整体 20 页以上，需要包含详细的论证过程、数据支撑与附录。: Twenty pages or more, including the detailed argument, the supporting data and an appendix.
